name: Whisper.cpp
tagline: High-performance C/C++ port of OpenAI Whisper for offline speech-to-text transcription.
real_test_summary: Tested locally on a MacBook Pro M2 using the base.en ggml model. The engine transcribed a 10-minute WAV audio file in 14 seconds completely offline with zero account requirements or usage caps.
pros: Zero-dependency C/C++ implementation runs offline on CPU or GPU with 4GB RAM
Fast local transcription throughput on Apple Silicon and standard CPUs
Permissive MIT license with no account signup or API fees
cons: Command-line interface requires manual compilation and model file downloads
Requires converting audio inputs into 16kHz 16-bit WAV format prior to transcription
